name: Sour Player
subtitle: The music player for Hermes Music

apps.name: Sour Player
apps.subtitle: The music player for Hermes Music
apps.localizedDescription: Play your Navidrome / Hermes Music library on your iPhone: lock screen and Control Center controls, AirPods buttons, background playback, offline playlists, the Sour Stage, profiles, listen along and Group Play.

privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Sour Player connects to your music server and Hermes Music on your home network.

versions.localizedDescription: No more network errors (the app runs from your Hermes Music; type its address the first time). A real iPhone look: tab bar, floating mini player, sheets, large titles. No zooming on text boxes, no keyboard shortcuts.
Music keeps playing in the background and changes songs with the screen locked; lock screen, Control Center and AirPods buttons work.

apps.name: Sour Player TV
apps.subtitle: Run the party on the TV (admins)
apps.localizedDescription: For Hermes Music admins: your iPhone runs an event's Group Play and plays the music; with Screen Mirroring the TV shows the party big (cover, lyrics, up next, chat and reactions) without the buttons. People you add can queue songs from their own Sour Player.

privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Sour Player TV connects to Hermes Music on your home network.

versions.localizedDescription: First version: the party on your phone, a clean picture of it on the mirrored TV. Needs Hermes Music 3.8.3.
